articles.title: What 350 career homers means to Cincinnati Reds slugger Eugenio Suárez
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds veteran slugger Eugenio Suárez on Tuesday, Sept. 22, became the 10th active player in MLB with 350 home runs.

articles.title: Cubs clobber Reds to reach brink of clinch, lose star Alex Bregman
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs beat the Cincinnati Reds 9-1 in the final game of the season at Great American Ball Park. The Reds finished 38-43 at home this year.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs beat Cincinnati Reds to inch closer to playoff clinch
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs scored late to beat the Cincinnati Reds Sept. 19. They can clinch a playoff berth as early as Sunday's series finale at GABP.

articles.title: Reds' Chase Burns is nearing an important milestone in his development
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds 23-year-old pitcher Chase Burns is looking to reach 30 starts in 2026. He made start No. 29 in the Reds victory over the Cubs Friday.

articles.title: Why Cubs' Ian Happ is the Cincinnati Reds' prototype free agent target
